title: HINT-Plan: Human Intention-Aware Robot Task Planning in Context-Rich Environments using Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.17771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Approaches to incorporating human awareness into mobile robot decision-making mainly focus on collision avoidance in low-level motion planning, often overlooking the challenges posed by human presence and high-level behavior. To address this vacancy, we present HINT-Plan, a novel approach to integrate human intention prediction into robot task planning. HINT-Plan employs Vision Language Models (VLMs) to anticipate high-level human intentions from third-person image observations, convert them into goal states, and solve joint task-planning problems. To effectively enable scene awareness in context-rich environments, we use hierarchical Scene Graphs (SGs) as high-level representations of the environment, and translate environmental topology and actionable knowledge into formal planning language to ensure executable plans. translated_title: HINT-Plan：使用视觉语言模型在丰富上下文环境中进行人类意图感知的机器人任务规划
translated_abstract: 将人类感知融入移动机器人决策的方法主要集中于低层运动规划中的碰撞避免，往往忽视了人类存在及高层行为所带来的挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了HINT-Plan，一种将人类意图预测集成到机器人任务规划中的新方法。HINT-Plan利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）从第三人称图像观测中预测高层人类意图，将其转化为目标状态，并求解联合任务规划问题。为了在丰富上下文的环境中有效实现场景感知，我们使用分层场景图（SGs）作为环境的高层表示，并将环境拓扑和可操作知识转化为形式化规划语言，以确保计划的可执行性。在照片级逼真仿真中的评估显示，HINT-Plan在人机联合任务规划中达到了69.71%的总体成功率。
tldr: HINT-Plan提出了一种利用视觉语言模型从图像观测中预测人类高层意图，并结合分层场景图将环境知识转化为形式化规划语言的新方法，实现了人机联合任务规划，在逼真仿真中达到69.71%的总体成功率。
en_tdlr: HINT-Plan introduces a novel approach that leverages Vision Language Models to predict high-level human intentions from image observations and employs hierarchical Scene Graphs to encode environment knowledge into formal planning language, achieving a 69.71% overall success rate in joint human-robot task planning.
